_comment: Security headers per report section A3. connect-src is set to Google Apps Script, matching the ENDPOINT in assets/js/form.js — both script.google.com and script.googleusercontent.com are required because /exec redirects. GoHighLevel is intentionally absent from connect-src: the CRM push happens server-side in leads-sheet/apps-script.gs, so the token never reaches the browser. api.leadconnectorhq.com stays in frame-src for the booking calendar only. Test on a preview deployment before promoting to production.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://link.msgsndr.com; connect-src 'self' https://script.google.com https://script.googleusercontent.com; frame-src https://api.leadconnectorhq.com https://link.msgsndr.com; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://script.google.com https://script.googleusercontent.com; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
